answer_1.quote: Data-to-Text refers to the process of generating accurate and fluent natural language text from structured data such as tables, lists, graphs etc. ... In this work, we focus on generating text in non‑English languages ...
answer_1.outputs: lexicalized natural language sentences describing restaurant information

answer_2.quote: We use the suite of word‑overlap‑based automatic metrics from the E2E NLG Challenge, supporting BLEU, ROUGE‑L, METEOR, CIDEr. We also compute a Slot Error Rate (SER) metric ...

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluations on a set of 200 examples ... measure two metrics – accuracy and fluency. Human raters are shown the gold text and the predicted text ... each example is rated by 3 raters.
answer_4.guideline: Raters judge whether the generated text accurately conveys the meaning (accuracy) and rate its naturalness on a 1‑5 scale (fluency).
